verdict.rationale: Reclaim's core product proposition is exactly this: it auto-schedules Tasks, Habits, and buffers as smart calendar blocks around meetings, defends focus time, and automatically reschedules/reshuffles when conflicts arise (e.g. reclaim-docs-7, -9, -12, -29, -1, -14). Community evidence corroborates real-world use of auto-scheduling and re-planning around commitments (reclaim-comm-3, reclaim-comm-9, reclaim-comm-10), though one user reports a specific sync/reschedule failure (reclaim-comm-5). Missing for 10: independent benchmark/quantitative evidence of re-planning accuracy at scale, and broader resolution of the one reported failure case.
